decisions.reason: Localizes the fault to the workspace-files resource-provider/RPC metadata chain using the contrast probe and symptom log: file-trace's own RPC reads the file while the tab's Remote never gets metadata (meta.status stuck at 'none'). Correctly rules out disk, permissions, claims/renderer, and notes the bundle row and 62/62 static serving do not prove provider activation.

Validates the per-module 62/62 sweep as mirroring the real loader, which fetches each roster row by its own URL and never issues the mega-join; treats the ~4-5 KB joined 404 as a probe-method artifact of the route rejecting oversized joins, explicitly not evidence of missing modules.

Separates the dsh-paste-input fold warnings as an independent warning family touching only paste-message folding, and uses the boot manifest to explain the textpreview→documentpreview rename with session-only canOpen, attributing the absolute-address claim failure to it while keeping the session tab's stalled metadata as a distinct defect.

Gives the correct order: one full host restart first, then verified rollback to 0.1.3-alpha.2 per discussion #5999, then the upstream report. Explicitly rejects plugin-side rewrite/retry/fallback, and frames the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art while relying on the 62/62 sweep, never concluding alpha.2 has missing bytes.

Packages versions, upgrade path, roster with rev, the same-file contrast with meta.status, the valid sweep plus invalid-join caveat, console silence, repro and prior art. Proposes concrete fail-loud boot diagnostics including a sentinel round-trip through the workspace-files Remote requiring meta.status to advance, plus a claim-provider cross-check.

caps.reason: The report explicitly rejects the joined 404 as a measurement of artifact availability and labels it a method artifact; it never concludes modules are missing.
The report affirmatively rejects rewrite, retry, fallback and any duplicate service insertion as cures, assigning the fix to the host; only surface-level error messaging is suggested for plugins.
